summary: Scale up to a 12-month, 754-paper pool and a 10-batch rolling feedback sequence (268 labels total). Rolling profile mean AUC 0.910 vs frozen 0.891 (delta +0.018; wins 4 / ties 3 / losses 2), recency 0.512 - far weaker than the single-split +0.05, so the earlier feedback gain was an overestimate. Also records a critical methodology defect: the labelling prompt includes the seed titles, inflating seed-based AUC by construction. E-RANKING and E-FEEDBACK-VALUE stay not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 8729d9c. Tooling/tests/docs + new labels; evaluation annotator used for labelling only.

budget_impact.rationale: No runtime-provider call. Evaluation annotator spend this unit: about 24 calls at ~6.3k tokens each (~150k tokens) to label 233 new items; labels are cached so re-runs spend nothing. Runtime operations/ceilings unchanged.
budget_impact.before: 754-paper 12-month pool did not exist; feedback test was a single 22/23 split.
budget_impact.after: Time-spread pool + stratified labels + rolling command; feedback gain measured as marginal and inconsistent; prompt-bias defect documented.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; evaluation tooling only, not product quality

open_risks: Labelling prompt reveals seed titles -> seed-based AUC inflated by construction; labels must be regenerated after the prompt fix.
Proxy labels shared between feedback and evaluation.
Feedback gain marginal (+0.018) and inconsistent (2 losses); not evidence of 'learns over time'.
